tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Use when the user wants hotel recommendations or wants hotels compared. Returns up to 20 hotels compared on the same criteria, each with area, nearest station, amenities and price where known; empty fields mean unknown, not bad. shortlist_url is a page you can share with the user comparing the top r

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Hotel details: address, star class, amenities, Staylist's AI overview (a written summary with pros, cons and who the hotel suits, where one exists), how the hotel compares with others in its city, check-in/out times, child policy, the hotel's own published policies (including whether it accepts gues

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Guest reviews for one hotel from the last 24 months (up to 1,000, newest first), via Staylist's booking partner LiteAPI (Nuitée booking guests and Tripadvisor). Returns how many were 1–2 star (a score of 4 or less out of 10) and the texts of those bad reviews, so the traveler can see what went wrong

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Return the approved booking links for a hotel (the same links shown to people on staylist.world) plus the Staylist hotel page. Property links open the exact hotel on Trip.com or Klook, where the traveler picks dates and room; preserve these URLs unchanged. Dated offer links, when present, are sorted

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Popular starting points with country codes. Optional; this list does not restrict which destinations can be searched. No provider search quota is used with the live provider.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_hotels, get_reviews, get_booking_link · Public sink: search_hotels, get_reviews.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_hotels, get_reviews, get_booking_link · Public sink: search_hotels, get_reviews

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
